summary: Boqii Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at its annual general meeting of a capital reduction and share sub-division. The par value of each issued share will be reduced from US$0.16 to US$0.0000001, with the credit transferred to a distributable reserve after Cayman Registrar registration. Authorized share capital will be changed from US$20,000,000 to US$12.5. The filing is a routine corporate action, not a special situation event. No deal terms or activist campaign are present.
